sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - DTC Brand Webstore

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law foundation with residual French Civil Law influences; company law codified in the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force)
PACER Plus — Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (trade and investment, in force 2020)
WTO Accession (2012); no comprehensive double-taxation agreements — Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia and New Zealand apply

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2020 (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap 222] ss. 7, 34 and 91 (as amended); VFSC Fees and Regulatory Directives; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) guidelines; FATF Recommendations 10, 24 and 25 as applied domestically

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the home jurisdiction, with notarization by a notary public or the licensed VFSC registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Vanuatu is not a Contracting Party to the HCCH 1961 Apostille Convention; documents require notarization, attestation by the origin-state Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalization by the Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post. An origin-country apostille is accepted only as supplementary due-diligence evidence at the registered agent's discretion.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the beneficial owner's jurisdiction, notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same path as above; apostille accepted as supplementary evidence only)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference / financial standing letter for each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank maintaining the beneficial owner's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, register extract, and certificate of good standing for any corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declaration for each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the beneficial owner's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Sanctions List, EU restrictive measures, and Vanuatu domestic designations; Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) status determined regardless of the 25% UBO threshold, with enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring; adverse-media checks and 24-month refresh required; suspicious transactions and threshold declarations reported to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) under the AML/CFT Act 2020.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Registry Online Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu); name search and reservation conducted exclusively through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English, French, or Bislama rendered in Latin script with an English/French transliteration where the brand contains non-Latin characters; a Vanuatu International Company name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or a prescribed abbreviation; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to a name on the VFSC register or reserved by another applicant.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / Banking / Banking Business — prior license and consent of the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) required
Trust / Trustee — prior VFSC/RBV regulatory consent required
Insurance / Assurance / Reinsurance — prior RBV insurance license required
Fund / Mutual Fund / Collective Investment — prior VFSC license and Ministerial approval required
Securities / Exchange / Stockbroker — prior VFSC securities dealer license required
Casino / Gaming / Gambling — prior VFSC gaming license required

Government / Crown / Commonwealth / Republic / National / Ministerial — words suggesting government patronage or public authority are prohibited unless written consent of the Minister responsible for the International Companies Act is obtained
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the registered agent may, within 14 days, (i) request written grounds of refusal from the VFSC Registrar, (ii) file an administrative appeal supported by a fresh representation letter, or (iii) submit a revised name with a new reservation fee; the 90-day reservation is not extendable — a lapsed reservation requires a new application; sensitive-token names require the relevant regulator's written consent to be appended to the appeal; exhaustion of administrative review precedes any judicial review in the Vanuatu Supreme Court.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. An International Company must at all times maintain a registered office in Vanuatu and a VFSC-licensed registered agent (International Companies Act s. 34); the registered agent's physical office is the statutory registered address. Because the entity conducts exclusively offshore DTC e-commerce via Shopify with no Vanuatu-resident staff or premises, no local operational seat is required; disclosure of the agent's address to VFSC satisfies the statutory mandate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated <5% probability of an unannounced physical inspection during the first financial year for a low-risk DTC e-commerce IC maintaining current filings, statutory registers, and an updated UBO file; VFSC retains full statutory inspection, document-production, and interview powers under the International Companies Act and AML/CFT Act 2020.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and reservation fee (first name, via licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per VFSC Fees Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (standard authorized share capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per VFSC Fees Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent appointment — first year
AML/CFT KYC, UBO piercing, PEP and sanctions screening, and UBO register maintenance — per beneficial owner
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark under AML/CFT Act 2020 obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of the KYC document bundle — per principal (5-document bundle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, origin-state Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Vanuatu consular post

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence opinion and UBO structure review (external counsel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border pre-incorporation opinions

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992, consolidated as Cap. 222 (IC Act), Part II (Incorporation) ss. 5–10; International Companies (Fees) Regulations; International Companies (Records) Regulations; Companies Act Cap. 191 applies only to domestic companies and is dis-applied to International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry — International Companies Section, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber, submitted with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company) via the VFSC e-Registry portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; no escrow or capital deposit requirement. The IC Act permits authorized capital of USD 50,000 or such amount as resolved; at least one issued share of USD 1.00 (or no par value) must be allotted to the subscriber upon incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, as a written consent of the sole subscriber, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission on [DATE] be adopted in full. RESOLVED that the subscriber named in the Articles be allotted one fully paid Ordinary Share of USD 1.00 at par at incorporation. RESOLVED that the registered office be and is hereby established at [Registered Agent], Port Vila, Vanuatu, for the receipt of all statutory notices. RESOLVED that [Director] be appointed sole Director and [Secretary] be appointed Corporate Secretary, each empowered to open bank accounts, execute the Shopify Terms of Service, and appoint payment processors, such appointments to continue until removed by ordinary resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Name Reservation Desk (e-Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the VFSC e-Registry or via a licensed registered agent. The proposed name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', or 'Inc.' and must not contain prohibited words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance', 'Assurance', or any term implying government patronage unless licensed. Three ranked alternatives should be filed to avoid delay.
required_dossiers: VFSC Name Reservation Application Form
Certificate of subscriber identity (notarized passport copy or corporate extract)
Permit/consent letter if any regulated word is used (not expected for this scope)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, submit revised name alternatives within 5 business days; VFSC does not charge a resubmission fee for non-conflicting names. A formal appeal may be filed with the Registrar of International Companies under the IC Act if a name is unreasonably withheld.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — International Companies Section (via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English in accordance with Schedule 1 of the IC Act. The Articles must set out authorized capital, the special license clause (if any), director powers, and indemnity provisions. The subscriber must execute the Memorandum and Articles before a notary public or in the presence of the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 — Application for Incorporation of an International Company
Memorandum of Association (executed)
Articles of Association (executed)
Consent to Act of each proposed director and the corporate secretary
Consent of the licensed registered agent
Subscriber identification evidence and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: VFSC issues a deficiency notice identifying missing clauses or signatures; cure by amendment and re-execution within 14 days through the registered agent. If the application exceeds the statutory processing period, the agent may request expedited priority handling with VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Government Fees and Electronic Filing Submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance Unit / e-Registry Payment Gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official incorporation fee of approximately USD 250 (VT 30,000) together with the VFSC registration levy via bank transfer, credit card, or agent consolidated payment. Upload the fully executed Form IC-1, Memorandum, Articles, and consents to the VFSC e-Registry portal. Ensure the payment reference number is cross-referenced to the application ID to trigger review.
required_dossiers: Completed and executed Form IC-1
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Bank transfer receipt or card payment confirmation
Consent letters of first director, secretary, and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is rejected or unallocated, reconcile the transfer with the VFSC Finance Unit within 3 business days and resubmit the payment reference. An overpayment is credited to future annual license fees; underpayment requires top-up before filing proceeds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification of documents and clearance of fees, VFSC registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique company number, incorporation date, and official seal. Obtain a Certified Extract of Company Particulars confirming the registered agent, registered office address, and directors in office. The company acquires legal personality and limited liability from the date stated on the Certificate.
required_dossiers: VFSC filing confirmation and fee receipt
Certificate of Incorporation (issued by VFSC)
Certified Extract of Company Particulars (issued by VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, a written rectification request with the original Certificate must be lodged with VFSC within 10 business days for re-issuance at no additional fee. Lost Certificates may be replaced upon submission of a statutory declaration and indemnity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Statutory Registers, and Registered Office Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board of Directors / Corporate Secretary (registered office at the licensed agent's premises, Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (or adopt a written resolution) to allot the subscriber's share, fix the registered office address, and appoint the corporate officers as set out in the pro-forma resolution. Open the statutory registers prescribed by the IC Act — Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Secretaries, and Register of Charges — and maintain them at the registered office. Issue share certificates and file the allotment return if required by the Articles.
required_dossiers: Signed First Board Resolution (pro-forma resolution adopted)
Statutory Register of Members
Statutory Register of Directors and Secretaries
Register of Charges (nil opening entry)
Share certificate(s) issued to the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: This step is internal governance with no regulatory filing; any defect in minutes or registers is cured by amending the registers in writing and having the secretary initial the correction. Late allotment entries do not attract penalty if remedied before the first annual license renewal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Certificate of Good Standing and Offshore Trading Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Compliance and Policy Department / Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request a Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC and a confirmatory letter that the International Company, being prohibited from trading with Vanuatu residents under the IC Act, requires no domestic Business Licence (Cap. 245) for non-resident DTC sales via Shopify. Register the domain and brand if trademark protection is desired through VIPA. Retain the tax-exemption certificate confirming zero corporate tax, zero withholding tax, and zero stamp duty on offshore income. These documents satisfy the due-diligence requirements of Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Stripe.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Good Standing (issued by VFSC)
VFSC tax-exemption confirmation letter
Director resolution authorizing launch of the Shopify DTC store
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent consent
Beneficial ownership declaration (for payment processor onboarding)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a payment processor queries the offshore status, provide the VFSC Circular on IC tax exemption and the agent's legal opinion letter. If VIPA or the Municipal Business Licence Office incorrectly assesses the IC for a local license, submit an application for exemption under the Business Licence Act referring to s. 6(2) and the IC Act's restricted-activity clause.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives (VIPA Investment Facilitation Desk)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — Exempt Offshore E-Commerce Operation (ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110); VFSC Certificate of Good Standing serves as the operating authorization; no physical manufacturing or retail premises requiring an industrial operating permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change — Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 4 (Office and Administrative Activity Only); no Schedule 1 or Schedule 2 project threshold under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act No. 12 of 2002 is triggered by a digital DTC webstore with cloud-hosted infrastructure and no land disturbance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — zero wastewater discharge, zero VOC emissions, and zero hazardous waste generation from the retail webstore; domestic electronic waste (office computers) must be disposed through the Port Vila Municipal Council e-waste collection program; no effluent, stack, or ambient monitoring thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and structural load inspections are not applicable for the remote-only DTC operation; the registered office is housed in a licensed agent's commercial premises in Port Vila holding a valid Certificate of Occupancy from the Port Vila Municipal Council. Remote employees are subject to the occupational health and ergonomic guidance of Vanuatu's Employment Act Cap. 160; no hazardous machinery, chemical storage, or high-voltage installations are present in the virtual workplace.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — Government portal: https://www.gov.vu; corporate and offshore registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), portal: https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The International Company (IC) is formed through a licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act and receives a VFSC corporate registration number; a separate TIN/VAT ID is not required for an IC that conducts no Vanuatu domestic business. A Tax Exemption Certificate is obtained through the registered agent from VFSC/VRCD confirming exemption from Vanuatu income taxes. If the IC later makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding the VAT threshold, the prescribed VRCD VAT registration application must be submitted with the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, registered office confirmation, and projected turnover evidence; VRCD then issues a VAT registration number. For a pure offshore DTC Shopify brand, the company should remain outside the Vanuatu VAT registration net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu does not operate a check-the-box entity classification election and has not enacted hybrid mismatch or pass-through taxation elections. The International Company's tax-exempt classification is automatic under statute; no election is available to subject an IC to Vanuatu corporate income tax or to reclassify it for foreign tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998, administered by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 (approximately USD 34,000) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted; an offshore International Company with no Vanuatu local taxable supplies is not subject to the registration obligation
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, no digital fiscal stamping, and no continuous API clearance mandate is currently in force. Export declarations must be filed through the ASYCUDA World customs clearance system. VAT invoices, whether paper or electronic, must contain the prescribed particulars under the VAT Act. Shopify-generated invoices are acceptable as record evidence only when fully reconcilable to customs export documents, shipping records, and payment remittances.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered supplier may claim the 0% VAT rate on goods physically exported from Vanuatu to a non-resident where the supplier retains proof of export, including a customs-approved export declaration and transport documentation. Specified services supplied to a non-resident and consumed outside Vanuatu may also qualify for zero-rating if the effective use and enjoyment occurs outside Vanuatu. For a Vanuatu International Company engaged only in offshore DTC e-commerce sales, there is no Vanuatu VAT nexus and no zero-rating claim is required; where the IC is VAT-registered, the same export-evidence requirements apply and input VAT attributable to export sales may be refunded. Funds for export sales should be received within 180 days to evidence commercial reality and support the zero-rating claim.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged and approved through ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill / Master Waybill
Commercial Invoice and original purchase order
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT MT103 / payment credit evidence
Proof of non-resident buyer and foreign destination (customer address, IP/country record, delivery confirmation)
Certificate of Origin (where preferential tariff treatment or treaty benefit is claimed)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCD audit scrutiny applies to the complete export chain. Zero-rating is denied and 12.5% VAT is assessed on the full export consideration if the prescribed documentation is incomplete or inconsistent. Any VAT refund obtained on false evidence is retrospectively clawed back by protective assessment and recoverable as tax due with statutory interest. Civil penalties, including penalties up to the amount of the tax shortfall and further default penalties, apply under the VAT Act; criminal liability, including fines and imprisonment, arises for knowingly false customs declarations and fraudulent refund claims. The limitation period for reassessment is extended in cases of fraud, and the IC's tax-exempt status may be revoked or deregistration effected where the regime is abused.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) is the central bank and monetary authority, responsible for issuing banking licenses, supervising licensed banks, and administering foreign exchange and monetary policy functions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal currency convertibility regime across both current and capital account transactions. There are no statutory restrictions on profit repatriation, dividend distribution, loan repayment, or capital redemption for non-resident shareholders of an International Company. Convertibility hurdles are limited to standard bank-level due diligence, requiring proof of underlying transaction validity, source of funds, and compliance with amounts requiring notification under RBV reporting thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose mandatory surrender or conversion of export proceeds. Exporters may retain all export receipts in any freely convertible currency. However, banks must file prescribed foreign exchange and AML/CFT reports with RBV and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for transactions above established monetary thresholds, ensuring traceability of export-related trade flows.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to medium feasibility. Vanuatu does not issue electronic money institution (EMI) licenses to non-resident digital payment providers, and offshore EMIs regulated under FCA or EU frameworks may offer multi-currency transaction accounts but cannot directly clear VUV through RBV settlement infrastructure. Their dependence on correspondent banking in Australia or New Zealand introduces latency and execution risk, making them unsuitable for primary treasury operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is generally permitted for non-resident corporate directors using video-based KYC and certified or notarized identification, provided the company maintains a registered agent in Vanuatu and files compliant constitutive documents. For higher transaction limits or escalated risk profiles, a director interview may be required in-person at the bank's Port Vila branch, although this is not a universal statutory mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner and controller identification with corporate opacity; legacy bearer-share concerns for offshore entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current registered agent certificate, complete beneficial ownership register under the International Companies Act, corporate charter and shareholder resolutions, and sworn statutory declarations confirming the entity does not use bearer shares and that all UBOs are identified.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for revenue derived from US/EU e-commerce sales via Shopify, PayPal, and Stripe cannot be substantiated through conventional trade invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 24-month authorized provider settlement reports, processor payout logs, customer transaction records, refund and chargeback history, bank statements from previous payment solutions, and a certified mapping between the legal entity and the registered DTC storefront.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company status flagged as a potential tax evasion or conduit risk by correspondent banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission good standing certificate, tax exemption confirmation, evidence of local registered office and resident agent, board minutes establishing commercial substance in Vanuatu, and signed intercompany agreements documenting actual business operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and politically exposed person (PEP) screening triggered by cross-border counterparties, e-commerce customers, or payment intermediaries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: External compliance provider sanctions clearance report, jurisdiction risk assessment covering customer and supplier geographies, detailed supply-chain disclosure log for vendors and logistics partners, and contractual warranties from payment processors affirming their own sanctions and AML compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share capital or shareholder loan injections should be routed via SWIFT MT103 wire transfers from a reputable regulated bank to the designated Vanuatu operating or escrow account. The transfer instruction must reference a clear economic purpose such as 'International Company capital contribution' or 'Shareholder loan facility - VU_IC', accompanied by board resolutions, capital allocation letters, and source-of-funds evidence. For amounts exceeding significant thresholds, the receiving bank may request a written purpose statement and underlying investment confirmation, and all funds must pass standard AML screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlements for inventory procurement should be cleared using SWIFT MT103 for high-frequency mid-to-low value payments and commercial letters of credit (LC) at sight or with a 90-day tenor for bulk imports. Payment instructions must contain precise economic purpose codes and references such as 'payment for goods under purchase order [PO number]', and the bank should retain invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and customs declarations for audit and sanctions screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla FX forwards with RBV-licensed commercial banks for hedging USD-denominated e-commerce receivables into VUV
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV where a physical VUV settlement is impractical due to lead-time constraints
Cross-currency swaps between USD and VUV exclusively for matched underlying trade flows or capital transactions, subject to RBV compliance review and evidence of a genuine economic exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return confirming registered agent, registered office, directors, members and authorised capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation (anniversary-based; no fixed calendar date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of VUV 5,000 per return; VFSC default notice issued; continued non-payment beyond approximately 90 days exposes the International Company to administrative strike-off under section 90 of the International Companies Act; restoration requires VFSC reinstatement application, unpaid fee settlement, and court order if the company has already been dissolved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation under the Company and Association (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Beneficial Ownership Registry, filed through the licensed VFSC registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the annual return within 30 days of the incorporation anniversary; any ownership change must be declared within 14 days of the event and confirmed again at the next anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to VUV 5,000,000 and imprisonment up to 12 months for officers; daily penalties may accrue for continuing default; VFSC may suspend corporate filings and mark the company as not in good standing, which impairs banking relations and subsequent transfers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Notice of Change of Registered Agent or Registered Office (only upon occurrence of a corporate secretarial change)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 21 days of the change; not a recurring annual filing where no change occurs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty of VUV 2,000 to VUV 5,000 for late notification; an inaccurate registered-office record may invalidate statutory service of process and disrupt bank KYC reviews; no strike-off risk where the annual return remains current.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a non-licensed Vanuatu International Company conducting offshore internet retail. An audit becomes mandatory only if the IC holds a VFSC-regulated licence (banking, insurance, securities/dealer activity) or the Registrar directs an audit in the public interest under the International Companies Act. No financial statements are required to be filed with VFSC.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Vanuatu; IFRS for SMEs is accepted for a non-listed small IC electing to prepare general-purpose financial statements; an audit-exempt IC may instead maintain adequate accounting records sufficient to explain transactions under section 56 of the International Companies Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Vanuatu International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register under the Company and Association (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2021 and declare the register data to VFSC through the licensed registered agent. At each incorporation anniversary, the agent certifies the current beneficial ownership schedule together with the annual return; a shareholding transfer or any change of significant control must be notified to VFSC within 14 days. Failing to update or submitting a false confirmation constitutes a criminal offence against the company and its officers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (with share transfer annotations)
